# Hospitality Multi-agent Architecture

> A network of 5 specialized AI agents (Aetherix, Anima, Peritia, Tacet, Orchestrator) that turn hotel-operations data into decisions, then measure those decisions against real outcomes to keep improving. MCP-native, Python/FastAPI, built solo since late 2025. Public meta-repo — Aetherix and Tacet execution nodes live in separate repositories (Aetherix is private).

## Status vocabulary

Canonical across this repo, the execution-node repos and https://ivandemurard.com. Every component status uses exactly one of these five labels. "Built" means the code runs, not that anyone uses it yet.

- Built — deployed and exercised end-to-end on the target environment.
- Shadow-mode — runs on real data, but no decision is delivered to a human on that basis.
- Synthetic PoC — validated on fabricated data only; never met the real world.
- Design — specified (ADR, schema, contract), not implemented.
- Research — open exploration, no delivery commitment.

## Current component status

- Aetherix (F&B node): Built — private repo, 0 real users, staging on Fly.io.
- Decision Ledger (recommendation → manager response → measured outcome, one auditable record): Built — inside the F&B node. Say "outcome-tracked operational history", never "self-improving memory": the record is Built, the learning is not demonstrated.
- Aetherix forecast: Shadow-mode — benchmarked on real public data, no manager decision delivered on it yet.
- Tacet (environment node): Built — public repo, paused / maintenance mode since July 2026.
- Anima (guest memory node): Synthetic PoC — DPIA-gated, never run on a real guest. Canonical definition: a scope-gated guest memory, not a digital twin. It holds time-layered claims, each with a source, a confidence and an age, across the whole stay: during it (requests, interactions and events stated or recorded while the guest is in house, held in working memory), after it (a short episodic tail; durable preferences only when stated or repeatedly confirmed), and before it (booking data plus situational context only — travel disruption, local events, weather; no external data about the person — Design). It answers one question, "who is this guest, right now?"; it informs and never decides.
- Peritia (house-knowledge node): Design — contracts specified, not implemented.
- Bespoke Orchestrator: Design — proto-stub only.
- Meta-Learner & Hive priors: Research — no substrate yet.
